tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal la 'phrin las 'chol ba'i yi ge bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru ā tsar+ya pad+ma ye/ hūm̐ mthu ldan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /khyod ni sngon tshe 'og min chen po ru/ /zhe sdang me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /rak+ta chags pa'i rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po nyid/ /khams gsum dbang bsdud ting 'dzin nyid la zhugs/ /de tshe dug lnga chos nyid ngang rol pa'i/ /bdud dang dmu dang btsan dang rgyal po dang / /gying dang gnod sbyin mthu dang grangs med dang / /stobs ldan rtsal drag ldan pa khyod kyang 'dus/ /de ltar rta mgrin sprul pa'i 'khor rnams kyi/ /gdug rtsub kha rlangs mthu yi nad mtshon gyis/ /bskal pa'i 'jig rten stong par nye ba'i tshe/ /rta mgrin 'khor gyi khrod nas mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdo rje rdo rje ma zhes pa'ang snang / pad+mas khro dbang rgyal po la/ /gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan rta mgrin gyis/ /gtum mo'i rtsa sngags 'brug ltar bsgrags pa las/ /'khor gyi dregs pa thams cad 'dar zhing bsngangs/ /de tshe dregs byed kun dang gnod sbyin gtso/ /rtse dmar khyod la bcom ldan rta mgrin gyis/ /dbang bskur dam tshig phog nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas shing / /de rjes slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /rgya gar dur khrod chen po me 'bar gyi/ /gnya' ri dmar nag zur gsum rngams pa'i mdun/ /srin mtsho khol ma me lce ris kyi 'gram/ /brag dmar srin po lang 'dra'i sgrub gnas su/ /slob dpon chen pos rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol/ /de tshe dus shig tshe na srod kyi char/ /spyang ki khrag gi ral can bdun byung ste/ /de dag ngu zhing pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gnod par brtsams tshe slob dpon chen po yis/

/rta mgrin rgyal po'i ting 'dzin rab brtan pas/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar bas gcan gzan rnams/ /rta mchog bzhon pa'i skyes bu bdun gyur de/ /slob dpon nyid la bzod gsol phyag btsal nas/ /bdag ni gnod sbyin rgyal po rtse dmar te/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan khro rgyal rta mgrin gyis/ /dbang bskur dam tshig phog nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs de nyid yin/ /rgya gar yul du gnod sbyin rtse dmar zhes/ /yongs la grags shing bod yul gangs khrod na/ /mthu ldan lha btsan zhes su 'bod de mchis/ /de ltar gsol te pad+mas bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyi gnas dang srog snying gang yin smros/ /slar yang gnod sbyin rgyal pos 'di skad gsol/ /bdag gi gnas ni 'phags yul 'di nyid dang / /gtsang gi seng phug bya ba de yang lags/ /pha ni dmu rje legs pa zhes bya dang / /ma ni btsan rje zla ba thod dkar gyi/ /bu mo gnod sbyin bzang 'gran ma zhes bya/ /srog gi snying po sngon tshe rta mgrin gyis/ /dam btags tshe na gsung gi bka' dri med/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje pad+mas bsdus mdzad pa'i/ /rgyud chung gang de brag ri chen po 'di'i/ /stod phyogs brag ri srub ldan 'di yi nang / /bse las byas pa'i ga'u sen gang pa/ /de na yod kyi longs spyod mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma bgyid/ /de ltar gsol bas pad 'byung rab dgyes te/ /zab mo dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur nas/ /gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /zhes btags rgyud kyang gter nas spyan drangs te/ /gnod sbyin khyod nyid slob dpon srung mar mdzad/ /de nas gu ru pad+ma bod yul du/ /byon pa'i dus su glog ltar myur ba yi/ /rta mchog bzhon pa'i skyes bu bdun dag gis/ /mnga' ris dpal thang nas bsus bsam yas kyi/ /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / /'gran zla bral ba'i gnas mchog de nyid bar/

/skyel dang bsu ba'i 'phrin las cher sgrubs pas/ /slob dpon dgyes pa'i gsung las gnod sbyin gyi/ /rgyal po rtse dmar gnas pa'i yul de ni/ /gnas mchog de na nges par yod ces gsungs/ /phyis dus 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /khyad par bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /gtsug lag khang chen rnams kyi nyams gso dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i chos grwa gsar 'dzugs sogs/ /bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad tshe'ang / /stobs ldan gnod sbyin khyod kyis 'phrin las kyi/ /rnam 'phrul du mas bstan 'dzin bstan pa bcas/ /'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad ces yongs su grags/ /des na dang por bcom ldan rta mgrin dang / /bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs/ /mtha' mar 'khon ston sa skya'i rje btsun mchog /rim par byon pa rnams dang khyad par du/ /sngags 'chang bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /spyir gyi bstan dang khyad par sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /rin chen thod snod mkha' ltar yangs pa'i nang / /sha khrag gtor ma ka ra shing tog sogs/ /ro bcud ldan pa'i bza' ba ri ltar spungs/ /khrag zhag chang dang rgya ja la sogs pa'i/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /ga pur gur gum tsan+dan dkar dmar dang / /spos dkar la sogs dri zhim thu lu lu/ /ngo mtshar spos dud sprin ltar thibs se thib/ /gzhan yang mda' mdung ral gri shang lang sogs/ /rno ngar ldan pa'i mtshon cha bgrang yas dang / /khrab rmog gzhib sogs go cha bsam mi khyab/ /gser dngul byu ru mu tig mu men dang / /pad raka margad la sogs rin chen tshogs/ /kha thi ding dpon la si seng la sogs/ /gos dang dar zab mang pos sa gzhi khengs/ /seng ge stag gzig dom dred 'phar ba dang / /gung dang spyang ki la sogs gcan gzan tshogs/ /rta nag rting dkar glang chen ma he dang /

/sha ba rna ba bse ru rgo ba gnyan/ /g.yag rgod stobs ldan ra lug mang po dang / /rma bya ne tso khu yug ngang pa sogs/ /spu sdug yid 'ong ldan pa'i bya yi tshogs/ /srog chags rnams kyang dbang po kun tshang zhing / /rin chen rgyan spras bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam/ /gzhan yang bkra shis rtags brgyad rin chen bdun/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /yid bzhin nor sogs dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi/ /mchod sprin sa dang bar snang khyab pa 'di/ /gnod sbyin rtse'u dmar zhes su yongs grags pa'i/ /'phrin las mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /kun kyang tshim zhing rab tu dgyes gyur cig /da ni 'dod pa'i 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag 'di/ /sngar bzhin 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /rnal 'byor bdag la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs snying khrag thang la pho/ /lus sems phrol la rnam shes dbyings su sgrol/ /bskul lo rbad do gnod sbyin mthu ma chung / /snang srid dbang sdus 'phrin las rab rgyas mdzod/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs rgyud dri med kyis/ /rgyun chad med par bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / /dbus gtsang khams kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dbang du 'dus shing don gnyis lhun grub mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu 'phrin las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin rtse'u dmar po la rang gi 'dod don bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las 'chol ba'i slad du dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud ces bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin rgyal po'i bka' dri ma med pa'i rgyud chung gi dpe rnying bsam yas na yod pa lag tu byung ba'i rgyud kyi tshig don la zhib tu dpyad pas yid ches rnyed pa bzhin 'phrin 'chol gyi mgor thog mtha' bar gsum gyi dam tshig bskul ba dang sbyar ba'i chos skyong chen po'i byung tshul gsal bar bstan pa dang bcas pa 'di ltar sbyar ba'i nus pa la brten nas bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig
